sources.location: https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2020/10/PXD021658/Metadata.xlsx (sheets Figure 2/4/5/6: file name, sample id, MS/LC method, load)
ZIP central directories of the 4 RAW zips under https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2020/10/PXD021658/ (270 .raw folders)
_HEADER.TXT and _extern.inf inside the zips, read by HTTP range for 3 files per zip (12 files, all 4 groups, Oct 2019 and Jan 2020)
doi:10.1016/j.aca.2020.09.062 (PMID 33218478); closed access, not in Europe PMC full text, NOT read

claims.evidence: The 270 .raw folders inside the 4 zips match the 270 file names in Metadata.xlsx one to one; stems are unique. PRIDE lists only the zips, so the .raw names come from the zip contents.

_HEADER.TXT 'Instrument: SYNAPT-G2' in all 12 inspected files, MassLynx 4.1, ES+, resolution mode. PRIDE lists generic Synapt MS (MS:1001782), overridden. HDMS vs MS variant is not distinguishable from the header.

claims.value: 5 groups: BK+Ang2 standard (141 runs), Blank (116), Hb tryptic digest (6), GluFib standard (4), Protein mixture (3)
claims.evidence: Sample id text in Metadata.xlsx; _HEADER.TXT Sample Description agrees for the inspected files.

Figure 5 sheet lists in-silico tryptic Hb alpha/beta peptides (e.g. VLSPADK, VHLTPEEK) with human sequences; PRIDE organism Homo sapiens. This is INFERRED; the Hb source is not stated in the files read.
Peptide standards (BK, AngII, GluFib), solvent blanks; the protein mixture composition is not given in the files read.
Sample id 'Blank'. No digestion/reduction reagents or buffer claimed.

claims.value: Trypsin (MS:1001251) for Hb digest rows; not applicable elsewhere
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol: only a single offline tryptic digestion of hemoglobin; other samples are untreated proteins/peptides.

PRIDE: data analysed solely in full scan MS only. No PRIDE:0000659 descendant (DDA, DIA, PRM, SRM) describes MS1-only acquisition; DDA would be false. Column is required with no reserved word allowed, so the validator reports an error.
MS-only full scan, no search engine; PRIDE PTM field: No PTMs are included. Peptide mapping was done in GPMAW in-silico, not a deposited search.

claims.value: biological replicate 1; technical replicate = running index of run (sorted by file stem) within each source group
claims.evidence: PLACEHOLDER numbering to make rows unique; the deposit does not define replicates.
No fractionation (single injection per file); build default.

limitations: Paper (closed access) not read: Hb species, protein mixture composition, peptide standard source and amounts are taken only from Metadata.xlsx/PRIDE; Hb organism Homo sapiens is inferred from peptide sequences in Metadata.xlsx
comment[proteomics data acquisition method] cannot be expressed: no PRIDE term for MS1-only acquisition, written 'not available', validator error remains
Synapt G2 MS vs G2 HDMS undetermined from headers
Run-level conditions are NOT encoded: stationary phase (POROS R2/R3, LiChrosorb 5/10 um), flow rate (2-20 uL/min), injected volume, LC gradient/method names exist only in Metadata.xlsx
Source groups collapse all runs of a sample type; replicate numbers are placeholders
Raw headers inspected for 12 of 270 files (3 per zip); acquisition dates range Oct 2019 to Jan 2020 and were not written (optional column)
The reconcile 'cleavage_agent_contradicted' blocker is intentional: the record's tryptic digest applies only to the Hb rows
characteristics[sample type] 'study sample' fails the cache-only validator (cache artifact; PRIDE:0001013 verified live in OLS4); applied to analyte samples in this method-development study
Concentrations not encoded (BK/AngII 2.5 uM appears in some sample ids; protein mixture 0.25 uM; Hb/GluFib 25 pmol)
Metadata.xlsx sample ids and zip folders disagree for 191017_55-57 (labelled 10 um, in the 5 um date series); not used
